specializations.name: Apprentice

description.value: A generalist trainee who did not specialize and spent less on setup.

startingCredits.note: wf-specializations says 550; wiki-best-perks says "400 starting credits" for a normal Apprentice run. No value is shown as fact.

value: Start with a stock of Household Goods and Food
Skipping the intro adds a Food Neon Sign and a Household Item Neon Sign

advantages: Extra storage (Storage Bay) and sellable general stock from day one.

value: Savings adds 150 credits on top of the specialization credits.

specializations.name: Water Merchant

tag.note: No tag shown on the start screen.

description.value: Trading in scarce clean water.

value: Water Testing Kit (full of Water Testing Strips)
Bottle of Water (Large), filled with Ghostwater
Jug of Water, filled with Rustwater
Bottle Printer (Shabby) holding an Energy Cell
Skipping the intro adds a Water Neon Sign
startingInventory.note: wiki-water-merchant calls the purifier "HydroTech"; wf-specializations says "HydraTech".

advantages: Water testing and purification kit from day one.
disadvantages: Mislabeled water is the main way this start loses money (per wf-specializations).

value: wiki-water-merchant recommends Working Pipes (unlimited Rustwater), Savings, Short Sleeper and Bad Lease.

specializations.name: Fence

tag.note: No tag shown on the start screen.

description.value: Dealing in stolen goods and keeping them hidden from station security.

startingRent.note: wf-specializations gives 250; "increased starting rent" is corroborated by gamers-scenarios.

value: Start with a stock of Contraband
Immediate access to the Janitor Underground Exchange

advantages: Contraband stock, Smuggler’s Bay and Black Market standing from day one.

value: Sawyer's Crew's Underground Exchange unlock overlaps with this start's built-in access.
Model Citizen (+30 Security) does not reach the 20 Security threshold on Mark Up for this start (per wf-perks).

specializations.name: Rock Bottom

description.value: The mentor negotiated only a lease; you have the store and a will to survive.

startingCredits.note: wf-specializations: 0; wiki-best-perks: "zero credits"; wiki-starting-scenarios: "start with nothing".

startingInventory.note: No cassettes, no stock, no equipment.

disadvantages: No credits, stock, equipment or cassettes.

value: Savings and Welfare Program are recommended for this start by wiki-best-perks.

specializations.name: Hydroponic Farmer

description.value: Growing crops hydroponically in limited station space.

startingRent.note: wf-specializations gives 240; "increased starting rent" is corroborated by gamers-scenarios.

value: Start with a stock of Farming Supplies and Seeds
Decrepit Hydroponic System (Shabby) holding an Energy Cell, a Bottle of Water (Large) with Ghostwater, 2 × Eco Module and 2 × Ruined Module (not removable)

advantages: Hydroponic systems, seeds and nutrients from day one.

specializations.name: Gunsmith

description.value: Selling firearms and munitions, modifying weapons and handling licensed orders.

startingRent.note: wf-specializations gives 250, but neither it nor gamers-scenarios lists "Increased starting rent" among Gunsmith start-screen bullets. Treat with caution.

value: Start with a stock of Firearms and Gun Mods
Start with a stock of Ammunition
Class I Weapon Permit (in the Display Case)

advantages: Weapon permit, firearms, mods and ammunition from day one.
disadvantages: Permit requires Security reputation of at least 8 (per wiki-gunsmith, unverified).

value: Convict / Public Enemy lower Security reputation, which the weapon permit depends on (inference from wiki-gunsmith permit rule; unverified).

specializations.name: Chemist

description.value: Working with controlled substances and a chemistry lab.

value: Sector 13 Cartel faction (only exists in this start)

advantages: Full chemistry lab from day one.

value: Model Citizen alone does not reach 20 Security on Mark Up for this start (per wf-perks).

specializations.name: Rat Wrangler

description.value: Raising rats for meat.

value: Animal Cage (Shabby) with a Livestock Feed Dispenser

advantages: Breeding rat herd and feed from day one.

specializations.name: Aquafarmer

description.value: Raising fish in tanks for meat.

startingRent.note: wf-specializations gives 240; "increased starting rent" is corroborated by gamers-scenarios.

value: Start with a stock of Tilapia and Fish Food
2 × Recirculating Aquaculture System (Shabby), each holding a RAS Water Tank, Energy Cell, Tilapia (Male), Tilapia (Female) and Fertilized Tilapia Roe
2 × Jug of Water, filled with Ghostwater

advantages: Two aquaculture systems with breeding Tilapia from day one.

basePoints.note: User-reported from 100-REV6 screenshots and stated by three independent 1.0 sources.

firstRunLocksPerks.note: Four community sources say the Starting Perks panel is unavailable on the first run. No source lists perks that are only locked for first runs.

everyPerkUsesSlot.note: Negative perks also occupy a slot; Colorful Character occupies one of its own slots ("net 2").

exclusions.note: wiki-gunsmith confirms the full scavenge block and alternative scavenge perks are exclusive (no names given).

dumpingGroundSearches.note: From the Degenerative Osteoarthritis text ("Normal shopkeepers start with 5 daily max attempts").
